chart.title: Share of countries by gender of the head of government
chart.subtitle: The head of government is the chief officer of the executive branch of their country.
chart.note: This is recorded on December 31 of each year.

Number of countries in which head of gov.descriptionProcessing: We only count the countries that V-Dem covers in the given year. Where we impute a country's data from a historical entity it was part of, those imputed values are excluded from the count, because the country did not yet exist separately at the time.
